commit.message:
Update release-policy.md (#591)

tl;dr Update release policy to clarify that PMCs must provide one or more Project Download Pages and refer to them in announcement emails.

* Update release-policy.md

Add Project Download Page policy to legal release policy document.

* Update release-policy.md

Make each sentence start on a line to make it easier to edit.

* Update release-policy.md

Update announcement requirements to include explicit reference to the Project Download Page.

* Update release-policy.md

Remove reference to multiple sub-projects since it is already clear from context that multiple Project Download Pages are ok.

* Update release-policy.md

Capitalize Infra

* Update release-policy.md

Change wording but not policy on Infra Release Download Pages.

@@ -79,6 +79,9 @@ earlier, reporting can be done in the project's next scheduled board report.
 
 Projects SHALL publish official releases and SHALL NOT publish unreleased
 materials outside the development community.
+Projects SHALL provide one or more Project Download Pages as part of their web site.
+All Project Download Pages must conform to Infra policy on 
+[Release Download Pages](https://infra.apache.org/release-download-pages.html).
 
 During the process of developing software and preparing a release, various
 packages are made available to the development community for testing
